records.name: SetupSectionProgress
records.invariant: Progress is not service activation; source values remain in owning settings records

records.name: SetupDelegation
records.invariant: Responsibility assignment never grants underlying permissions or professional authority

records.name: ReadinessEvaluation
records.invariant: Derived versioned evaluation, not manually editable blanket ready flag

records.name: SetupEvidenceReference
records.invariant: No provider secrets or private health answers copied into public setup progress; mock/screenshots do not prove real capability

relationships: Progress/delegation/evaluation reference existing ENT-Workspace/Gym/PolicyVersion/company person/access/audit/file records and source policy catalogues; no duplicated financial/doc/template truth
concurrency: Expected versions on draft/assignment/publish; retry identities; source change invalidates cached evaluation; recheck current grants at resolution
retention: Follow existing reviewed policy; preserve audit, no invented duration
